name: Bin Pack Orderer
description: Orders items into fixed-capacity bins minimizing wasted space using bin-packing heuristics (first-fit, best-fit, worst-fit). Used when downstream consumers require batched, size-bounded chunks.
when_to_use: API or storage layer accepts fixed-size batches
Throughput optimization requires minimizing request count
Items have known sizes and bins have hard capacity limits
drawbacks: Reordering cost if late items arrive
use_cases: Bulk write to a database with batch size limits
